13.text:
<C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,><C:0001,0004,>- Here Lies a Hero of Buffness -
Muscle Lord Biceptus<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Biceptus almost single-handedly suppressed the
Great Protein Rebellion of the Vegebrodies.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>His turgid biceps were said to be infused with
a divine power no amount of lifting could match.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>When he swung his fist earthward, the very
ground would tremble for miles at his might.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Let the legends record that no clothes would
ever fit this Muscle Lord's body. Ever.<C:0003,0001,>
